_readme: EDITORIAL CORRECTION NOTICES — not marketing. Rewritten 2026-09-17 after the outreach strategy review (growth change log BB-CHG-0015). THE RULE: these messages tell an organisation that an independently researched page about them exists and invite factual corrections. They must NOT offer a free page, solicit a claim, ask for a link, or promote the site — a fact-check bundled with a pitch is still a pitch, and unsolicited marketing email needs prior consent in Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Italy, Japan and Serbia (the jurisdictions most of our contacts sit in). Check the recipient's jurisdiction before sending; when in doubt, don't. If a recipient ASKS for edit access, that reply is the invitation — send the manage link then, not before. Resolution (most specific wins): '<leg>:<type>' → '<leg>' → 'default'. Placeholders: {name} {short} {pageUrl} {parentName} {parentUrl}.

default.subject: Correction check: our page about {name}
default.body:
Hello,

I'm Pavel, the editor of BelgradeBest.com, an independent English-language guide to Belgrade. I'm writing as a courtesy, not a sales approach.

We have published a page about {name}, compiled from public sources:

{pageUrl}

Each fact on it carries the source it came from. If anything there is wrong, out of date, or missing important context, reply to this email and I will correct it — no conditions, and you don't need to do anything if it's accurate.

Best regards,
Pavel
Editor, BelgradeBest.com

If you'd rather we didn't write to you again, reply "no contact" and I'll record it permanently.

expo-2027:contractor.body:
